title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Lemme know when Mize is coming up. You probably know this by now but they got rid of me again
Now what you do? Stay out of trouble will ya! Not sure when Mize will come, will let you know when I know

Colangelo caused some trouble with me and my boss after I brought pizza in a couple weeks back. I’ve been working on a sensitive story about the Ilitch side he’s trying to keep out. Last day of camp, I had 2 pizzas and bread and a coke delivered to stadium in his name

He told my boss, my boss has no balls and re-assigned me. Union is fighting it so I’m in DC with my girlfriend until they figure out what’s next .... Thanks, let me know. I won’t put it out there until he knows.
